candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# CV

Data governance analyst with catalogue-maintenance, access-request handling and cross-team hand-over experience in a mobile app services team.

## Experience

- Maintained the data catalogue entries and the data-ownership register for the client-version and behavioural-log datasets after taking over the area in March; each entry was checked against the existing responsibility list before updates.
- Processed data-access requests and change tickets for the behavioural-log dataset in the catalogue system (Collibra), building a reproduction path for each rejected request and asking the compliance team to confirm scope.
- During change review, explained limitations, dependencies and options to the app-operations team; the responsibility list was handed over and reviewed by the compliance and business teams.
- Closed two full retrospectives by archiving my own decisions, team decisions and items still awaiting approval, limited to the catalogue-maintenance scope.

evidence.text: Maintained the data catalogue entries and the data-ownership register for the client-version and behavioural-log datasets after taking over the area in March; each entry was checked against the existing responsibility list before updates.

Processed data-access requests and change tickets for the behavioural-log dataset in the catalogue system (Collibra), building a reproduction path for each rejected request and asking the compliance team to confirm scope.
During change review, explained limitations, dependencies and options to the app-operations team; the responsibility list was handed over and reviewed by the compliance and business teams.
Closed two full retrospectives by archiving my own decisions, team decisions and items still awaiting approval, limited to the catalogue-maintenance scope.

Responsibilities included maintaining catalogue and ownership information and tracking data-access requests and changes over three months, with fact checks, exception logging and hand-over done together with the compliance and business teams.
Work sample: a responsibility list for the behavioural-log dataset with check steps and open items; the document keeps the catalogue system's verification trail from a test environment walkthrough.
Hiring manager note: a former colleague mentioned that the backlog of unresolved access requests went down by about 40% during the year he was there; no report or baseline was attached.
Interviewer note: seemed hesitant when asked about escalations; my impression is that he is not decisive under pressure.
